lemma IsMulIndecomposable.image_baseOf_inv_comp_eq [InvolutiveInv ι]
    [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
    (f : G →* S) :
    v '' baseOf v (invMonoidHom.comp f) = (invMonoidHom ∘ v) '' baseOf v f := by
  have key (f : G →* S) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ baseOf v f) : i⁻¹ ∈ baseOf v f⁻¹ := by
    obtain ⟨hi, hi'⟩ := hi
    refine ⟨by simpa [hv_inv] using hi, fun j hj k hk h ↦ ?_⟩
    replace h : v i = v j⁻¹ * v k⁻¹ := by
      rwa [hv_inv, inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, mul_inv, ← hv_inv, ← hv_inv] at h
    specialize hi' j⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv] using hj) k⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv] using hk) h
    simpa [hv_inv] using hi'
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨i⁻¹, ?_, by simp [hv_inv]⟩
    simpa using key _ i hi
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i⁻¹, key f i hi, by simp [hv_inv]⟩
